action.sql: SELECT SUM(m.rev) / 3.0 AS avg_monthly_revenue FROM (SELECT p.period, COALESCE(SUM(g.credit - g.debit), 0) AS rev FROM periods p LEFT JOIN gl_lines g ON g.period = p.period AND g.entity_id = 'CA01' AND g.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM accounts WHERE type = 'Revenue') WHERE p.period BETWEEN '2026-04' AND '2026-06' GROUP BY p.period) m
